summary.text: Randy Pettigrew, listed by Ballotpedia as Randall Pettigrew, is a Republican state representative from New Mexico who has represented House District 61 since January 1, 2021, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Pettigrew earned a B.S. in civil engineering from New Mexico State University.
His career experience includes working as an engineer and as senior vice president and principal construction services engineer with Pettigrew & Associates.
